hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && pnpm exec prettier --ignore-unknown --write "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|mts|cts|js|mjs)$' && pnpm nx affected -t test --files="$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
